items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, and some of these acts like Cher and Roberta Flack... [INTERVIEWEE] Roberta Flack was nice, yeah... But yeah, there were some great experiences man.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. I’m enjoying it. It’s great. Great hang, man.
Yeah, and some of these acts like Cher and Roberta Flack, was it a memorable experience or just one more day?

Roberta Flack was nice, yeah. That was I got to meet — oh it was a great drummer. I was on a couple of tracks and he was on another track. He’s a great player, oh I forgot his name. Anyway we hung out a while. I hung out with this drummer a lot on the gig. But you know playbacks, you’d sit together and talk. But yeah, there were some great experiences man. Like you know what I got to do that I really loved man, I used to do all of Elliot Lawrence’s work you know. I don’t know if you remember Elliot Lawrence.
